question: Which of the following devices is used to measure relatively high temperatures, such as encountered in furnaces?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pyrometer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pyrometer** 

 
 
• **The device for measuring relatively high temperatures, such as are encountered in furnaces. Hence, Option 2 is correct.**
 
• Most pyrometers work by measuring radiation from the body whose temperature is to be measured.
 
• Radiation devices have the advantage of not having to touch the material being measured.
 
• Radiation Pyrometers are used to measure the temperature of red hot metals up to 3000°C.</stro
